name: Peapods Finance
fix_description: In depositFromPairedLpToken, the _slippageOverride parameter has no upper bound validation. An attacker can set it to 999 (99.9% slippage tolerance) to force the contract to accept highly unfavorable swap prices after manipulating the pool. Fix by restricting _slippageOverride to a reasonable range (e.g., max 50 = 5%).
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a short flash-swap-based multi-step exploit involving Uniswap V2 callback logic, two Uniswap V3 swaps, and a protocol-specific rewards deposit function that must be understood in context. It is not deeply complex, but it does require reading the target protocol logic and chaining several interactions beyond a trivial access control or single-call bug.
